name: Valuations Details 1
definition: Valuation details for the securities position.

MarketPrice.name: Market Price
MarketPrice.definition: Last reported/known price of a financial instrument in a market.

SettlementDate.name: Settlement Date
SettlementDate.definition: Date and time at which the financial instruments are to be delivered or received effectively (Effective Settlement Date and Time).

AccruedInterest.name: Accrued Interest
AccruedInterest.definition: Amount of interest that has been accrued in between coupon payment periods for a given financial instrument.

CleanPrice.name: Clean Price
CleanPrice.definition: Price amount excluding the accrued interest for a given financial instrument.

NumberOfDaysAccrued.name: Number Of Days Accrued
NumberOfDaysAccrued.definition: Number of days used for calculating the accrued interest amount.

QuotationAge.name: Quotation Age
QuotationAge.definition: Number of days since the last pricing update.
